description: This file defines the QuickLaunchAPI class which provides an API endpoint for retrieving quick launch shortcuts for the dashboard in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for fetching the available shortcuts, with placeholders for create, delete, and validation logic. It leverages traits and external classes to manage user roles and API responses.

classes.name: QuickLaunchAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing quick launch shortcuts on the dashboard, providing retrieval functionality and placeholders for creation and deletion operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the list of active quick launch shortcuts, returning an ArrayModel with accessibility flags.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request, which are empty in this implementation.

methods.name: getActiveQuickLaunchItemArray
methods.description: Private method that compiles the list of quick launch items, marking items accessible based on user roles.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Placeholder for creating new quick launch items; not implemented.

methods.description: Validation rules for creating quick launch items; not implemented.
